mediatek_kb.name: MediaTek
behaviours: Some MediaTek-based consumer APs historically exposed WPS PIN attack surface on default configs.
recommendations: Disable WPS PIN on MediaTek-based APs when the management UI allows.
Prefer WPA3-SAE with PMF required on firmware that supports it.

tp_link_kb.name: TP-Link
behaviours: Selected TP-Link models appear in public WPS PIN research and default-PIN discussions.
recommendations: Disable WPS-PIN on TP-Link APs; prefer WPA3-SAE-only with PMF required where clients allow.
